City Council Meeting
AGENDA FOR LA MIRADA City Council Meeting
October 10, 2017 –
6:30
p.m.
COUNCIL CHAMBERS, CITY HALL, 13700 LA MIRADA BOULEVARD,
LA MIRADA, CALIFORNIA 90638
In-Person Public Participation Information
To address the City Council on an Agenda item other than a Public Hearing or during Public
Comments, please fill out a "Request to Address Council" card located in the back of the Council
Chambers near the agendas and submit to the City Clerk prior to the meeting or as soon as
possible. There is a five minute maximum time limit when addressing the City Council. The amount
of time for public comment may be reduced by the Mayor or by action of the City Council
Electronic Public Participation
To submit your Public Comments electronically in advance, please email your written comments to
cityclerk@lamirada.gov. The deadline to submit your Public Comment electronically is on the day
of a regular City Council meeting before 3 p.m. For special meetings, comments must be received
at least three hours prior to the meeting.
Members of the public may participate in this meeting via remote attendance by using the Zoom
Webinar information.
Zoom Meeting Details: www.zoom.us/join
Meeting ID: 897 8121 0338 Telephone Option: 1-669-444-9171
(*6 to unmute; *9 to raise hand)
Public Comment will begin with speakers attending in-person first followed by those attending via
Zoom Webinar.
Reasonable Accommodations
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, if you need special assistance to participate
in a City Council meeting or other service offered by the City, contact the City Clerk's Office at
(562) 943-0131. Notification at least 48 hours prior to the meeting or time when services are
needed will assist City staff in assuring that reasonable arrangements can be made to provide
accessibility to the meeting or service.
Agenda Materials
Copies of staff reports and supporting documentation pertaining to agenda items are available for
public viewing and inspection at City Hall during regular business hours and on the City's website
http://www.lamirada.gov. For further information regarding agenda items, please contact the
City Clerk's office at (562) 943-0131.

APPEARANCES, PRESENTATIONS, AND PROCLAMATIONS
6.1
RECOGNITION OF LA MIRADA LIBRARY MANAGER JENNIFER MCCARTY - It is recommended the City Council recognize La Mirada Library Manager Jennifer McCarty and present her with a recognition plaque for her years of service to the community.
6.1 Recognition of Library Manager Jennifer McCarty
6.2
RECOGNITION OF LA MIRADA AQUABELLES - It is recommended the City Council recognize the championship members and coaches of the La Mirada Aquabelles and present them with Certificates of Recognition.
6.2 Recognition of La Mirada Aquabelles
7.
APPOINTMENTS
7.1
APPOINTMENTS TO YOUTH COUNCIL - It is recommended the City Council reappoint Yvonne Chen, Karis Chun, Fabian Lee, Noemi Muñoz, Adriana Perez, David Ramirez, Maximo Vazquez, and Sarah Usmani and appoint Ariana Tirado to the La Mirada Youth Council for the term expiring in October 2018.
7.1 Appointments to Youth Council
7.2
APPOINTMENT TO THE GREATER LOS ANGELES COUNTY VECTOR CONTROL DISTRICT BOARD OF TRUSTEES - It is recommended the Mayor appoint a member of the City Council to serve as a member of the Board of Trustees of the Greater Los Angeles County Vector Control District for a two year term commencing January 1, 2018.
7.2 Appointment to Vector Control District

CAPITAL IMPROVEMENT PROJECT NO. 2016-14, SHERIFFâ€™S STATION EMERGENCY GENERATOR CONNECTION - APPROVAL OF PLANS AND SPECIFICATIONS - It is recommended the City Council find that pursuant to the California Environmental Quality Act of 1970, the project is categorically exempt under Section 15301 Class 1 (a) and will have no significant effect on the environment; approve the plans and specifications for Capital Improvement Project No. 2016-14, Sheriffâ€™s Station Emergency Generator Connection; and authorize the City Clerk to advertise for sealed bids.

9.

9.1
ORDINANCE NO. 700 APPROVING ZONING ORDINANCE AMENDMENT NO. 47 AND RELATED MUNICIPAL CODE AMENDMENTS, PROHIBITING ALL MEDICAL AND NON-MEDICAL COMMERCIAL CANNABIS ACTIVITY, PROHIBITING OUTDOOR CULTIVATION, AND REGULATING INDOOR CANNABIS CULTIVATION, CONSISTENT WITH STATE LAW - It is recommended the City Council conduct a public hearing as prescribed by law; affirm the CEQA Exemption; and introduce for first reading Ordinance No. 700 adding a new Chapter 9.132, "Cannabis Prohibition and Regulations," to Title 9 of the LMMC; repealing Chapter 21.48 "Medical Marijuana Dispensaries," of Title 21 of the LMMC; and adding a new Chapter 21.48 "Commercial Cannabis and Cultivation" to title 21 of the LMMC, consistent with state law, by title only, and waive further reading.
9.1 Ordinance No. 700

RESOLUTION NO. 17-31 AUTHORIZING THE USE OF SENATE BILL 1 (SB 1) ROAD REPAIR AND ACCOUNTABILITY ACT (ACT) FOR FISCAL YEAR 2017-18 - It is recommended the City Council adopt Resolution No. 17-31 authorizing the use of SB 1 Road Repair and Accountability Act for Fiscal Year 2017-18 and authorizing staff to submit the project list to the California Transportation Commission.
